notes.title: Amusing adventure game HIVESWAP: ACT 2 is out now
notes.content:
With no prior knowledge of the Homestuck web comic series needed, the second part of the video game adventure is out now with HIVESWAP: ACT 2.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/amusing-adventure-game-hiveswap-act-2-is-out-now

notes.title: Homestuck universe adventure HIVESWAP: Act 2 releases November 25
notes.content:
Ready for your next adventure? The second part of HIVESWAP with HIVESWAP: Act 2 has been announced that it's finally releasing on November 25.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/homestuck-universe-adventure-hiveswap-act-2-releases-november-25
